title: 12th Annual Hot Wheels Collectors Convention
summary: The 12th Annual Hot Wheels Collectors Convention took place in Anaheim, CA, in October 15–19, 1998. This is the first convention to offer Code 1 Hot Wheels models, with all previous models being Code 2 and Code 3 models. The guest of honor at the Convention was Ira Gilford.

title: Hot Wheels: The Creative Drive
summary: Hot Wheels: The Creative Drive (JPG38) is a 2026 coffee table book written by Dan Bova and Freddie Holmes, with contributions from the Hot Wheels Design Team as well as other external parties. The book was edited by Leah Tracosas Jenness, Kristin Mehus Roe and Elana Cohen and published by Simon & Schuster....

title: Premium Collector Set
summary: The Premium Collector Set assortment is an adult collector-focused premium set consisting of 4 vehicles in diorama-style packaging. All vehicles feature Real Riders wheels, diecast bodies and chassis.

title: Hot Wheels Let's Race 5-Pack (2026)
summary: The Hot Wheels Let's Race 5-Pack (JKG22) was released in 2026, with all cars being made in Indonesia. The cars in the 5-Pack are nearly identical (except the Shark Bite which is identical) to their previous releases. center|300px
